producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, A minor moving to C major in the drops. Warm, patient melodic house.

VOICE: Male, warm and plain, mid-range, sung softly and close with a little reverb. He sings only two short lines, repeated. Doubled an octave up later.

INSTRUMENTS: A rising analogue arpeggio, a soft four-on-the-floor kick, a rounded bass, warm pads, a brighter lead arpeggio in the drops, soft claps and shakers, strings in the last drop.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, arpeggio. 0:24 Vocal. 0:44 Build. 1:00 Vocal, doubled. 1:20 Drop 1. 1:50 Break. 2:08 Build. 2:20 Drop 2 with strings. 2:56 Outro, arpeggio slowing, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s melodic house: clean, wide and warm, arpeggios shimmering, kick soft.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The lead arpeggio arriving at 1:20.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 6 p.m. The first vocal track of the evening: gentle, hopeful and built from very little.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Unwinding, grateful, lifted, calm.
